subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: May this PR remove the three public WhatsApp admission projections before their compatibility path has completed, or must they remain as deprecated adapters while `turnAdmission` becomes canonical?
rationale: Repository policy requires compatibility preservation unless an owner explicitly approves an early breaking API removal; tests and CI cannot determine that product-contract choice.

options.title: Preserve deprecated projections
options.body: Derive the three redacted projections from canonical ingress facts, keep them through the migration window, and retain the prepared-turn refactor.

options.title: Approve early removal
options.body: Explicitly accept the callback compatibility break, document the breaking-release decision, and provide upgrade evidence for known consumers.

options.title: Split the refactor
options.body: Land history-finalization and prepared-reply ownership separately while deferring the public admission-shape change.

recommendation.title: Preserve deprecated projections
recommendation.body: Derive the three redacted projections from canonical ingress facts, keep them through the migration window, and retain the prepared-turn refactor.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has prior shipped ownership history in the WhatsApp connection boundary and is implementing the current admission-boundary refactor. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases?ref=thelgtm.dev&utm_source=openai))
